name: Sakurai Chiharu
source: A young girl left in the care of the Nihon Daiichi Gakuen Affiliated Hospital for ten days due to illness. She becomes a scholastic's use patient, a patient used to assist medical students learn. Her doctor seems to enjoy embarrassing her.
